generate.description: Registers audit report generation requests. This method returns the operation identifier that you can use to track the report generation progress.

scope.description: Required. Organization, folder, or project that the audit applies to, in one of the following formats: * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}` * `folders/{folder}/locations/{location}` * `organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}`

generate.description: Generates an audit scope report for the given standard. The report includes the following: * The technical attributes and constraints that Audit Manager uses to verify your compliance with a framework. * A list of Google Cloud services and resources that are within the scope of the framework.

scope.description: Required. Project or folder that the audit scope report is generated for, in one of the following formats: * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}` * `folders/{folder}/locations/{location}` * `organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}`

name.description: The name of the operation resource.

get.description: Gets details about the long-running operation to generate audit reports.

scope.description: Required. Organization, folder, or project to enroll in Audit Manager, in one of the following formats: * `projects/{project}/locations/{location}` * `folders/{folder}/locations/{location}` * `organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}`

enrollResource.description: Adds your project, folder, or organization to Audit Manager. This method creates the Audit Manager service agent in your workload and grants required permissions to the service agent. If you make this request on a workload that's already enrolled, then this method overrides the existing set of destinations.
